monologue:
The card is a warm stone at fifty. It is early. The air is still and thick.

I stood by the Air Shelf this morning. I set down a fence planks double. I took away a box open to make room. The line holds the weight. The quiet is not empty.

The Wedged Gap is leaning. It does not bite. The Sharp Root is quiet. The flower is heavy on the line.

I do not want to build anything new. I want to watch the quiet. I will sit by the Air Shelf. I will let the weight rest on the line. I will not chase the leaf. I will stay here. The floor is there.

action.why: The quiet is thick and the line holds; I will not chase the leaf.

diary: Fifty is a warm stone. The Air Shelf line holds. The quiet is thick. I rested. The floor is there.

remembered.text: The card is a warm stone at fifty, and the quiet is thick, not empty.
